propositions: Plan reviews must distinguish planning phase (stricter criteria) from execution phase (fixed 0.80 blocking floor) in compiled state and manifest attestations.
Winning process_status transitions to in_progress set execution phase; transitions to open set planning phase; other targets and losing fork events preserve the current phase.
Manifest attestations must emit review-phase and optional priority-floor in fixed order after advisory and before rebar-version, with execution requiring exactly 0.80 floor.

Phase compatibility validation must accept planning/legacy attestations in any state, accept execution attestations in execution state only when floor >= 0.80, and reject syntactically valid policy violations as incompatible.

Pre-signing collection must capture an immutable PlanReviewGeneration baseline before LLM/probe, with transactional verification under lock requiring exact HEAD and generation match, retrying at most three times on HEAD instability.

Re-sign recovery must parse review-time phase/floor from v2 JSON sidecar, compare against compiled phase, refuse incompatible/malformed variants, and reconstruct manifest from recorded values rather than inferred phase.
